negative_reviews.author: Amy Kenney
negative_reviews.text:
We got the £18 lunch special (+£2 for steak).
Edamame was barely cooked, the noodles were slimy in our ramen, like they’d been sat for a while. Food came out suspiciously quick (I know it’s 30 mins or they pay) steak and egg was freezing cold, even the broth didn’t warm it up. We ended up getting half price as we didn’t eat even a quarter of our meal. Staff were friendly but didn’t check on us after they gave us our food and seemed to be rushing around when it wasn’t overly busy.
